parameters.name: AutoSnapshotPolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy.

parameters.name: AutoSnapshotPolicyName
parameters.description: The name of the automatic snapshot policy. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain characters that are classified as letter in Unicode, including Chinese characters, English letters, and digits. The name can also contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-).

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the automatic snapshot policy list. The results are displayed on multiple pages.

Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page when the automatic snapshot policies are displayed by page.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the automatic snapshot policies that you want to query. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group. If you use this parameter to filter resources, the resource count cannot exceed 1,000.

>Filtering by the default resource group is not supported.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the automatic snapshot policy. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. The tag key cannot contain http:// or https://.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the automatic snapshot policy. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://.
